source.inspectionScope: Fresh full30-line EWS null-output guard patch read with full Bug and review. Current receiver and Rust delete-event path preserve idempotent local-delete echo handling. Reuse existing exact nullable lookup/deletion lesson; no crash or server replay executed.

text:
commit 32021aed9e9286157f96132b5d4e33f55dc04397
Author:     Brendan Abolivier <brendan@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Thu Mar 27 17:27:58 2025 +0000
Commit:     Brendan Abolivier <brendan@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Thu Mar 27 17:27:58 2025 +0000

    Bug 1956298 - Don't try to delete already-deleted messages. r=heather
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D242959

diff --git a/mailnews/protocols/ews/src/EwsFolder.cpp b/mailnews/protocols/ews/src/EwsFolder.cpp
index 7ea45b74978..4b69f0d7fc8 100644
--- a/mailnews/protocols/ews/src/EwsFolder.cpp
+++ b/mailnews/protocols/ews/src/EwsFolder.cpp
@@ -202,6 +202,15 @@ NS_IMETHODIMP MessageOperationCallbacks::DeleteHeaderFromDB(
   rv = db->GetMsgHdrForEwsItemID(ewsId, getter_AddRefs(existingHeader));
   NS_ENSURE_SUCCESS(rv, rv);
 
+  if (!existingHeader) {
+    // If we don't have a header for this message ID, it means we have already
+    // deleted it locally. This can happen in legitimate situations, e.g. when
+    // syncing the message list after deleting a message from Thunderbird (in
+    // which case, the server's sync response will include a `Delete` change for
+    // the message we've just deleted).
+    return NS_OK;
+  }
+
   return mFolder->LocalDeleteMessages({existingHeader});
 }
title: Bug 1956298 - Don't try to delete already-deleted messages. r=heather
